mechanism: A call brings members to the canvas who then start or extend the mark and say how far it has come.
mechanism_fails_if: In a room, build reports come only before any call, or calls are followed by no build report at all.
bound: Where a member has begun the mark before any call, the call follows the first build report and recruits to a mark already started.
counterexample_response: xenoblade_chronicles reports building at h25.0 and first calls at h33.6: a starter placed first and the call came to a mark already begun. 53 of the 190 rooms run this way. Response: a scope condition (the bound), not a withdrawal; the arrow keeps its order where the call opens the work, and the starter element (R01) carries the other route.
